input:
Subject: Duplicate charge on invoice INV-2001

We were billed twice for INV-2001 this month. Please refund the duplicate today, our payment run closes this afternoon.

Subject: Need a copy of last quarter's invoice

Could you send a PDF of invoice INV-2002? Our accountant needs it sometime next week.

Subject: Update billing address

Please change the billing address on our invoices to the new office. No rush, the next invoice is a month away.

Subject: Card declined and service suspended

Our card was declined after an expiry change and the workspace is now suspended. Our whole team is locked out, please reactivate it urgently.

Subject: Dashboard returns a 500 error

Every report page has shown a 500 error since this morning. Our team cannot work until it is fixed.

Subject: CSV export has wrong column order

The exported CSV lists the date column after the amount. It is a minor annoyance, nothing is broken.

Subject: API rate limit questions

What is the request limit for the reports endpoint? We are planning an integration for next quarter.

Subject: Cannot reset my password

The reset link for user@example.com says it has expired every time. I need to get into my account before a client meeting in one hour.

Subject: Add a teammate to our plan

Please add colleague@example.com as a member of our workspace. Whenever you get to it is fine.

Subject: Close our account

We are winding down this project and would like to close our account and export our data. There is no deadline.
